title: I spent $200 to buy ads for my game. The cheaper one did better?
author: MapApprehensive1867
selftext:
I have been running meta (facebook/instagram) ads for my game. The first ad (3days) was with a simple banner, it saw huge views. I redid the image and started second ad with better poster, it had much better click rate but low view. Not really sure what's going on, but here is the full report.
    
    
    ## All ads — September 15
    
    
      ### 1. 3 day ads
    
    
      - Status: Running on Meta
      - Spend: $69.42 / $100
      - Views: 46,700 impressions
      - People reached: 27,689
      - Clicks: 579
      - Click-through rate: 1.24%
      - Cost per click: $0.12
      - Attributed players: 198
      - Time remaining at check: 29h 29m
    
    
      ### 2. 1 day ad
    
    
      - Status: Running on Meta
      - Spend: $50.18 / $100
      - Views: 12,242 impressions
      - People reached: 10,451
      - Clicks: 286
      - Click-through rate: 2.34%
      - Cost per click: $0.18
      - Attributed players: 212
      - Budget remaining: $49.82
      - Time remaining at check: 5h 46m
    
      ### Total reported
    
      - Spend: $119.60
      - Views: 58,942 impressions
      - Clicks: 865
    
    

  
  
  
Here is my game link if you want to check: [https://run.world/silverbolt106/gt-rush-coastal-life-3d](https://run.world/silverbolt106/gt-rush-coastal-life-3d)

comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body:
I don't get your game and I don't get why you advertise it. 
No offense, I just don't get it

replies.author: MapApprehensive1867
replies.body:
I get your question. It's for game jam and credits were free, so why not.   
  
As for game, everything is done by the in game phone on right. You can start by doing small delivery by Dasher app, then move on cooking shifts, firetruck, paramedic etc. There is messaging app with notification on it which explains some stuff, but I guess it's easy to miss. You can get out of car by pressing T or clicking Exit \[Car icon\] on bottom.  


It's mainly made to run smoothly on phone web browser. Thanks for feedback, I will improve on-boarding and tutorial.

replies.author: Fuzzzy420
replies.body: Tutorial in form of a Telefon call would be nice.

replies.author: MapApprehensive1867
replies.body: Yes, good idea. Calls won't be missed.

replies.author: Fuzzzy420
replies.body:
I played on phone. Why not have the default control. This seems counter intuitive. 

Good luck

replies.author: MapApprehensive1867
replies.body: Not sure what you mean by default control..

replies.author: Fuzzzy420
replies.body: Control circle left and buttons right

replies.author: MapApprehensive1867
replies.body:
'Instantly get Teleporter back to car'

There is a button on bottom right as shortcut to teleport to car, maybe it's being accidentally touched?

'It seems you put a lot of effort into systems besides the core gameloop.'

Thanks for feedback, I will make it better.

replies.author: Fuzzzy420
replies.body:
Yes that's what I pressed. It said just car on it. 
At the moment this feels like a Roblox mod.

replies.author: MapApprehensive1867
replies.body: I thought this quality was good on phone, but will update models.

replies.author: SeasonedAdManager
replies.body:
You’ve got AI. You know how to use AI.

Use AI to build a library of best practices and resources. Deep research how to run, design, write, target and test Meta ads. 

20 year, day 1 Facebook Ads user here. Working on my own SaaS project to destroy the alternatives in the market.

replies.author: MapApprehensive1867
replies.body: Thanks for the advice. Tho, I am not using meta ads directly, it's provided by third party run world. Credits provided by them. The ads itself are beta feature there, I asked AI and it said I would need access to meta ads manager which is not provided, either that or talk with run staff themselves.
